input.quote: NOTWITHSTANDING THE FOREGOING, NOTHING IN THIS SECTION 16.5 IS INTENDED TO OR SHALL LIMIT OR RESTRICT THE AMOUNTS PAYABLE TO THIRD PARTIES UNDER THE INDEMNITIES PROVIDED PURSUANT TO ARTICLE 10, SECTIONS 16.1 AND 16.2 ABOVE; PROVIDED, FURTHER, THAT THE FOREGOING LIMITATION OF LIABILITY SHALL NOT APPLY IN THE CASE OF GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT.
input.rationale: Section 16.5 is a mutual exclusion of special, indirect, punitive, incidental and consequential damages, with carve-outs for third-party indemnities under Article 10 and Sections 16.1/16.2 and for gross negligence/willful misconduct. However, those carve-outs operate only against the consequential-damages disclaimer; nowhere in the Agreement (Articles XVI, XVII or elsewhere) is there any monetary or fees-based aggregate cap on direct liability, so both Parties' direct exposure — including Ono's broad product-liability indemnity in Section 16.1 — is unlimited. That fails the fallback on a material term (no mutual cap based on 12 months of fees). We therefore add a single new Section 16.7 at the fallback level: a mutual aggregate cap of 12 months' amounts payable by Ono, with indemnification obligations, breach of Article 10 (Confidentiality) and gross negligence/willful misconduct expressly outside the cap. Section 16.5's mutual consequential-damages waiver is left untouched.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual aggregate liability cap of 12 months' amounts payable, with indemnities, confidentiality and gross negligence/willful misconduct outside the cap.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement disclaims consequential damages but contains no aggregate liability cap, so both Parties' direct liability is unlimited. We have added a mutual cap at 12 months' amounts payable by Ono as new Section 16.7, with indemnification, confidentiality and gross negligence/willful misconduct sitting outside the cap; this is our fallback position.

ops.text: 16.7 Limitation of Liability. Except with respect to each Party's indemnification obligations under Sections 16.1 and 16.2, either Party's breach of Article 10 (Confidentiality), and either Party's gross negligence or willful misconduct, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the fees and other amounts payable by Ono under this Agreement during the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the claim.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
